0022600200.text: The Celtics arrive at 6-2 and second in the Atlantic, 1.5 games back, with a one-game winning streak, though they are only 1-2 on the road this season. The Bucks are 1-7, fifth in the Central and 15th in the East, and are on a four-game losing streak after an 0-4 start on the road. Boston leads the season series 1-0 after a 109-102 win in Boston, and it won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
